reasoning: Shows a checkmark over a horizontal base line, the standard UI glyph for 'download complete' or 'saved offline', and secondarily 'approved/verified on a line'. It fits tasks about downloading files for offline use or final verification, though in a task list any checkmark icon risks blending in with the completion checkboxes.

readings.meaning: verified or approved entry on a form line

pass1.ambiguity: Can be mistaken for a generic checkmark (which duplicates the to-do checkbox itself) or for a download arrow if glanced at quickly.

distinguishing: Shows a checkmark centered directly above a single flat horizontal baseline (indicating a finished download or a checked signature/entry line), whereas the look-alike places three staggered horizontal list bars to the right of the checkmark.
